$agent.description: Loud warning for any agent that meets this file with no folder context.

closedThrough.description:
Last week closed out, or null if none ever were. Close-out is strictly sequential, so one pointer replaces a set of closed weeks — and only one week ever shows the close affordance.

Also the window's left edge: the grid starts at the oldest unclosed week.

vacationDays.description: Days marked vacation. In the file because agents must not schedule into them.

IsoDate.description: Calendar date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Never a timestamp — the grid has no time-of-day.

colorToken.description: Token name from the theme ramp (`barA`, `barB`, ...), not a literal color.

notes.description: Markdown. Bullet lists render under the title.

projectId.description: Project id, not name — renames must not rewrite every item.

rank.description: Base62 fractional index. The single ordering spine, never displayed. Scoped to siblings: global order = roots by rank, then each root's children by rank.

marks.description: Sparse cell map, date -> mark. At most one mark per (item, date), matching the mutually-exclusive cell menu. Replaces the handoff's single `due` / `done_on`.

recurrence.description: Rule only. Occurrences are generated at read time and never written.

Mark.description:
A cell value. Modelled as a discriminated union so that `{ kind: 'due', provenance: 'deliberate' }` is a COMPILE error rather than a runtime throw, and so `provenance` is REQUIRED on a skip rather than optional.

That second property is the important one: a skip that loses its provenance is indistinguishable from one that never had it, which would make three months of absence look identical to three months of avoidance in the skip-streak data.

SkipProvenance.description:
How a skip came to exist.

`deliberate` — the user chose to skip while present. `auto`       — auto-close resolved an unresolved recurring occurrence during                catch-up, because returning to a neglected weekspan must never                cost more than a glance.

Skip-streak surfacing must count only `deliberate` skips. Without this split, three months away would write a dozen auto-skips onto a weekly item and drown the very signal skip exists to expose.

monthday.description: 1..31. Required for `monthly`. Months that are too short are skipped, not clamped.

anchor.description: Series start. Also fixes the phase for `biweekly` (which fortnight is "on").

until.description: Inclusive last date the series can generate, if bounded.

title.description: Resolved once on paste and cached here so chips render offline.

kind.description: Favicon/kind hint. Icon BYTES live in a per-device cache, never in the file.
